profile.name: Maria Santos
profile.summary: Hospital cleaner and environmental services aide with 3 years of housekeeping experience. Comfortable working independently on busy units.

descriptions: Clean and disinfect 18-22 patient rooms per shift on medical and surgical units
Dry and wet mop corridors, the cafeteria and the kitchen dish room
Collect and dispose of general, recycling and biohazard waste following hospital protocols
Bag and transport soiled linen to the laundry chute
Operate an auto scrubber and floor burnisher on 3 floors
Restock hand hygiene and cleaning carts at the start of each shift
Cleaned 14 guest rooms per day and restocked supplies
Infection control, WHMIS, floor care equipment
